- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Migrate rerun and straggler runtime consumers to `cfg.rerun_state_machine` and `cfg.straggler`, keeping the existing config classes separate.

- Use config values for rerun initialization, loss checks, and straggler setup/reporting.
- Resolve tracker-file skipped iterations and FP16/fake-process-group normalization centrally in once-only container finalization. Keep section validation pure and repeatable.
- Preserve the shared CLI loss/gradient-check flag while allowing independent native loss and gradient settings.
- Use `report_determinism_stats` as the canonical config value; retain `--rerun-mode report_stats` as a CLI alias.
- Preserve Core's rerun checkpoint restore precedence, replay behavior, straggler cadence, and detector placement. Fault tolerance/autoresume is out of scope.

Compatibility note: existing `--rerun-mode report_stats` commands remain supported and now map to Core's canonical mode, fixing their previous initialization failure. Native configs use `cfg.rerun_state_machine.rerun_mode = "report_determinism_stats"`; `report_stats` is a CLI-only alias.

Based on pinned main; no dependency on the pending model, optimizer, DDP, or checkpoint migrations.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: [MB-1917 — C14 + C15](https://linear.app/nvidia/issue/MB-1917/c14-c15-migrate-rerun-and-straggler-configuration-in-one-pr)

## Code provenance

No code copied from external repositories.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel, I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test (not applicable: no kernel changes)
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the autoformatter.sh on my PR

Validation at `4dfc89869575a95c354034e941bdae0c79e0e536`: 383 focused tests passed. Six hardware-specific parameters were excluded on the local SM89 GPU; the four failing SM90-only cases were reproduced on the pinned baseline. Scoped formatting/import checks passed; unrelated baseline formatting was not changed.

Pinned before/after comparisons passed for default configuration, fresh/save/resume, injected-error replay, and straggler enabled/start-disabled behavior. The separate deterministic-mode fresh/save/resume pair also passed. No Core checkpoint code or format changes.

Review follow-up at `dca7fd603`: 166 focused argument/config/MIMO tests passed (six hardware-specific parameters deselected). Rerun CLI generation now uses the argument factory; the three pre-`pretrain()` MIMO files are unchanged from the baseline.

### Code review

Independent full-diff review completed with no blocking findings. This PR remains draft for maintainer review and CI.

#### Step 1: Mark PR as "Ready for Review"

Mark ready after merge conflicts are resolved and CI is passing.

#### Step 2: Final Review

For changes outside `megatron/core`, the Core final-review step is skipped.

#### Step 3: Approved

The Approved label is applied automatically after required approvals.

### Merge

Merge through the normal maintainer workflow.
